Hattrem

Psychic

Galar · Generation 8

Hattrem is a Psychic-type Serene Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 4.8 kg. It evolves from Hatenna and into Hatterene. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (86), with a base stat total of 370.
